meta.siteTitle: HOKU Design | Apps Built from Clinical Experience
meta.siteDescription: HOKU Design is a two-person app studio run by a former nurse and a physical therapist. We publish apps for healthcare, lifestyle, and games.

hero.lead: HOKU Design is a small app studio created by a nurse and a physical therapist. From tools that help healthcare professionals to games that brighten everyday life — each app is made with care.

appsSection.title: Our Apps
appsSection.lead: Healthcare, lifestyle, and games. Apps born from real clinical challenges and everyday joy.

hokuIslands.title: Hoku Islands
hokuIslands.lead: A community map where Hawaii travelers share photos and experiences. Explore spots across the islands on a 3D map.

about.lead: HOKU Design is a two-person app studio led by a former nurse (CEO) and developed by a physical therapist. We believe that combining the perspectives of nursing and rehabilitation creates tools that truly work in real clinical settings.
about.strength1Body: Having both worked with patients in nursing and rehabilitation, we notice the tools that are truly missing. We turn those insights directly into apps.
about.strength2Body: Our assessment methods and statistical techniques follow clinical and research standards, ensuring accuracy you can rely on in real practice.
about.strength3Body: Simple, bright UI that's easy to use even in a busy clinic. We deliver apps that fit seamlessly into people's everyday lives — from healthcare to play.
